property_summary: After any call to CashOut, the sum of all balances in the contract should be unchanged or decreased by the withdrawn amount, not increased.
After a CashOut call, the caller's balance does not increase.
After a CashOut call, the total balance of the contract (sum of all user balances) does not increase.
After a CashOut call, the sum of all balances in the contract does not increase.
After a CashOut call, the caller's balance plus the amount withdrawn equals the prior balance (before the call), i.e., balance never increases when withdrawing.
The balance of any address never decreases after a call to CashOut when the caller has sufficient balance.
After any CashOut call, the total sum of all balances in the contract is non-increasing relative to the state before the call.
After a CashOut call, the recorded balance of the caller (msg.sender) is exactly the previous balance minus the withdrawn amount, provided the call succeeded and the caller had sufficient balance.

After CashOut, the total balance of the contract (sum of all user balances) plus the contract's ether balance equals the contract's ether balance before the call minus the withdrawn amount if the call succeeds.
A deposit always increases the balance of the depositor by exactly msg.value.
After any sequence of operations ending with a CashOut, the caller's balance never decreases by more than the amount withdrawn.
After any sequence of deposits and a cashout, if the caller has sufficient funds, the sum of all balances across all addresses never decreases by more than the total amount withdrawn in that cashout.
After a CashOut call with any non-zero amount `_am`, the caller's balance either remains the same (if the CashOut did not execute due to the if-condition) or decreases by exactly `_am`.
After a deposit then CashOut, the contract's total balance cannot exceed the sum of all user balances plus the initial deposit.
After any CashOut call, the sender's balance does not become negative.
After any sequence of calls ending with CashOut, MinDeposit remains unchanged from its initial value of 1 ether.
After any call to CashOut that would revert, the reverted call should not change MinDeposit from its initial value.
After any sequence of calls ending with a successful CashOut, the MinDeposit value must equal its initial deployment value (1 ether) regardless of the amount withdrawn.
After any sequence of calls ending with a CashOut call, the MinDeposit value must always equal its initial value (1 ether) regardless of the amount withdrawn.
After any sequence of deposits and a CashOut, the contract balance never exceeds the total of all deposits that were >= MinDeposit.
After any CashOut, the sum of balances is always less than or equal to the total contract balance minus the minimum deposit threshold.
After any CashOut, the total contract balance equals the sum of all balances mapping entries.
After any CashOut, the contract's total balance equals the sum of all recorded deposits that were greater than MinDeposit, minus the CashOut amount.
After any sequence of deposits and a CashOut, the contract's balance is never less than the sum of all balances in the mapping.
For any caller and any amount, after a CashOut call, the new balance is the old balance minus the withdrawn amount only if the withdrawal succeeded.
After a withdraw, the contract's balance decreases by the withdrawn amount if and only if the CashOut call succeeds.
The MinDeposit state variable remains unchanged after any sequence of calls including CashOut.
After a CashOut call that reverts, the sender's balance in the mapping remains unchanged.
After a CashOut call, the Deposit state variable (i.e., the MinDeposit value) remains unchanged.
The contract balance never decreases when calling CashOut(uint256) after a Deposit.
After a CashOut, the contract's balance is at least what it was before the CashOut minus any ether sent out.
After CashOut, the Deposit state variable equals the sum of all deposits minus the sum of all cashouts.
After any number of calls ending with a CashOut, the contract's balance is at least the sum of all deposits (minus cashouts) as recorded by the TransferLog.
After CashOut, MinDeposit remains unchanged.
After CashOut(uint256), the caller's balance in the contract should decrease by the withdrawn amount, not increase.
After CashOut, the sum of all balances in the contract never exceeds the previous sum minus the withdrawn amount (which would be violated if balances increase instead of decrease).
After a successful CashOut call, the caller's balance in the C contract decreases by exactly the withdrawn amount.
After a successful CashOut call, the contract's Ether balance decreases by exactly the withdrawn amount (since the refund comes from the contract's own balance).
After CashOut, the stored balance of the caller in the contract is strictly less than the stored balance before the call, provided the caller had a non-zero balance.
The state variable balances[msg.sender] must never increase after a call to CashOut.
After a call to CashOut(uint256) where the caller's initial balance is zero, the balances mapping for that caller should not underflow, i.e., should remain zero for any withdrawal amount.
After a call to CashOut(uint256) with any amount less than or equal to the caller's balance, the caller's balance decreases by the withdrawal amount and never increases.
After a successful CashOut call (not reverted), the caller's balance should decrease by exactly the withdrawn amount and never increase.
After a call to CashOut, the caller's balance never exceeds the value it had before the call, regardless of the withdrawal amount.
After CashOut reverts due to insufficient balance, the caller's balance should not have been deducted.
When CashOut fails because the call returns false, the balances mapping should remain unchanged.

After a call to CashOut, if the internal call fails (returns false), the total of all balances minus msg.value (the amount sent back) remains unchanged, but the buggy version does not revert so the sender loses their balance even when the call fails.
After CashOut(uint256) finishes (revert or not), the caller's balance is only reduced if the internal call succeeds.
When CashOut fails due to the internal call returning false, the sender's balance must remain unchanged.
The balance of msg.sender decreases by exactly _am after a successful CashOut(_am) call.
After calling CashOut, the sum of the caller's balance and the contract balance remains unchanged from before the call if the call succeeds.
After a successful CashOut(_am) call, the caller's balance in the balances mapping decreases by exactly _am.
After a successful CashOut(_am) call, the caller's balance in the balances mapping decreases by exactly _am.
After a successful CashOut(_am) call, the total ether in the contract (address(this).balance) decreases by exactly _am.
